annotations.title: Rename a song, change its genre or tempo

description: Changes the title, the genre (not while the song is being mixed) or the tempo of a song. get_song_status shows the tempo and whether Bandmixr detected it.

genre.description: Genre of the song. rock_indie = rock / indie; pop = pop; acoustic = acoustic, singer-songwriter; hip_hop_grime = hip hop, rap, trap, grime; electronic = electronic, EDM, house, techno; reggae_dub = reggae / dub; orchestral = orchestral, film score; metal = metal; jazz = jazz; blues = blues; funk_soul = funk / soul / R&B; punk = punk; other = anything else or not sure (balanced, genre-neutral).

songId.description: The song id from list_songs or create_song.

tempoBpm.description: The song's tempo in beats per minute (40 to 240), as the person gives it: echoes in time follow it. It replaces a tempo Bandmixr detected. null = not known (Bandmixr may detect one with the next draft).

title.description: The song's name, as the person calls it.

name: update_song
